title: Saludos y el bar
summary: Greetings, please/thank you, and your first bar de tapas — with vale and venga

blocks.title: Hola and its friends
blocks.body: *Hola* works any time of day. Spaniards also greet with **buenas** — a friendly, all-purpose short form of *buenos días / buenas tardes*. To ask how it's going: **¿qué tal?** (the everyday one) or *¿cómo estás?* You answer with *bien* (good), *muy bien*, or *tirando* (getting by).

blocks.title: vale and venga — the glue of Spain
blocks.body: Two words you'll hear every three seconds in Spain: **vale** = 'OK / got it / sure' (agreement, all day long), and **venga** = 'come on / alright then / let's go', often to wrap up or nudge things along. *— ¿Nos tomamos una caña? — ¡Venga, vale!*
blocks.callout: *vale* is Spain's national word. Latin America doesn't use it like this — it's a Spain giveaway.

blocks.prompt: A friend says *¿nos tomamos algo?* (shall we grab something?). Which reply means 'sure, let's'?
blocks.explain: *¡Vale, venga!* — agreement plus a let's-go nudge. Peak Spain.
